name: Knowing The Future
overview: Scripture reveals that true knowledge of the future rests solely with the LORD, who has sovereignly ordained all days and knows every word before it is spoken, as seen in Psalms 139:4 and 139:16. Human understanding and devices cannot ultimately determine what shall stand, but trusting in God's counsel and guidance is essential (Proverbs 3:5, 19:21). False prophecy is sternly condemned, emphasizing that only those who speak by God's command reveal His truth about the future (Deuteronomy 18:20). God's Word serves as a guiding light, directing believers faithfully along His path amid uncertainty (Psalms 119:105).
